notes:
Account snapshot: mid-market B2B SaaS (CRM-adjacent) building in-app agent for support + internal ops. Wants to start on Hosted API to iterate quickly, plan to move to Dedicated once latency & cost profile validated.

SLOs mentioned on calls: target interactive latency for agent responses 150ms p50, <=350ms p95 for short-turn conversations (<=200 tokens). Throughput baseline: ~25 concurrent agent sessions, occasional spikes to 100 sessions during peak.

Key technical asks: streaming + function/tool-calling support (rely on streaming tokens for progressive UI render), deterministic fallback routing if model hits rate limits, prefix/KV cache to reduce repeated prompt cost. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations (quant profiles + batching) to lower unit cost while preserving prompt-quality.

Quality gating: wants prompt/evals regression gating integrated in CI for agent behavior. Requirements: A/B + canary rollouts for model/prompt changes, automatic evaluation against golden prompt sets and conversational evals, alert on quality regression beyond 2% metric drop. Keen on eval dashboard that ties latency + quality tradeoffs so product team can approve canary rollouts.

Security/compliance: must have SSO/SAML, audit logs for prompt/response retention (30-90d), optional VPC for Dedicated. KMS support required if move to Dedicated/Private.

Pricing posture: cost-sensitive but willing to commit to reserved capacity if Dedicated delivers predictable p95 latency at target. Wants examples of cost delta vs hosted for their workload.

Quotes/utterances: "We need streaming to feel instantaneous — even a few hundred ms variance kills the UX."; "If we can gate regressions in CI, we can push model changes weekly."

Decision process & stakeholders: Product lead (Emily Park), Eng manager (Ravi Singh), Head of Security (Marta Lopez). Procurement engaged for Dedicated pricing once POC validates latency.

POC scope: 2-week hosted-API POC (chat+tool-calls), synthetic perf tests + 100 real user beta, eval harness (10 prompt sets) for regression gating. Next: schedule canary rollout plan with Redwood SE to test A/B flows.
prompt_eval_requirements: CI-integrated evals: golden prompt sets (10-20), automated eval run on model/prompt change, metrics = answer_accuracy(annotated), hallucination_rate, latencies (p50,p95). Require A/B comparison reports and canary gating threshold (alert if quality delta > 2% or p95 latency degrades >20%). Wants simple SDK hooks to trigger canary and rollback.
commercial_notes: Initial ARR estimate 100k-250k. Customer prefers 12mo reserved pricing if Dedicated meets p95 SLO and cost < 40% over hosted run. Legal to review standard enterprise T&Cs.
implementation_plan: Phase 1: Hosted POC (2 weeks) - integrate streaming chat + function calls, collect eval metrics. Phase 2: Perf validation & pricing - run synthetic and beta traffic, decide Dedicated commitment. Phase 3: Canary rollout + Eval gating - setup A/B pipelines and rollback automation.
internal_owner_notes: AE to push pricing examples for 3 capacity tiers; SE to provide canary rollout template + eval harness; schedule security deep-dive w/infra on KMS/VPC options.
win_criteria: 1) Hosted POC shows p95 <=350ms at peak and pass quality gates. 2) Eval harness indicates no regression vs baseline (<=2% delta). 3) Pricing acceptable -> commit to Dedicated (12mo).
